scenes.narration: In AI Center X, you start with the AI Canvas: the CV Screening Assistant's business problem, its data, and the people it affects. Then you simulate the risks.
onScreen: AI Canvas excerpts: business problem, data, people affected

scenes.narration: An AI agent suggests risks, each cited from the MIT AI Risk Repository and the AI Incident Database. You select the relevant ones and save them. Now, generate the mitigations.
onScreen: Suggested risks, each with its MIT AI Risk Repository class and AI Incident Database incidents

scenes.narration: For every saved risk, the agent proposes mitigations, each classed by MIT's draft taxonomy and tied to the EU AI Act. Again, you select and save. Next come the model enhancements.
onScreen: Suggested mitigations for the saved risks, cited from the MIT AI Risk Mitigation Taxonomy (draft) and EUR-Lex

scenes.narration: The agent shows how to put those mitigations into effect: fine-tuning on audited shortlists, two checking agents, and learning from audited recruiter feedback. You save the ones you need.
onScreen: Model enhancements: fine-tuning, agent workflow and human feedback, each tied to a saved mitigation

scenes.narration: Three years, now less than an hour: your key risks, mitigations and enhancements are identified. Then scale up: models, data lineage, programmes, architecture and intelligence, on one acceleration platform. AI Center X: make AI deliver value.
